name: Erlang
runtime: BEAM VM (bytecode execution, with a JIT available since OTP 24)

runtimes.name: BEAM VM
runtimes.role: The Erlang virtual machine, built for massive concurrency and fault tolerance.

runtimes.name: BEAM JIT (OTP 24+)
runtimes.role: Translates BEAM instructions to native code as modules are loaded rather than using an adaptive hot-path optimiser.

compilers.name: erlc
compilers.role: Compiles Erlang source to BEAM bytecode.

concurrencyModel: Actor-style lightweight processes with isolated ordinary heaps, asynchronous message passing, and preemptive scheduling. Facilities such as ETS provide explicitly shared runtime-managed storage.

codeExample.source:
-module(hello).
-export([start/0]).

start() ->
    Pid = spawn(fun() -> loop() end),
    Pid ! {self(), "Hello!"},
    receive
        {Pid, Reply} -> io:format("Got: ~s~n", [Reply])
    end.

loop() ->
    receive
        {From, Msg} -> From ! {self(), Msg ++ " World"}
    end.
